title: task.create
description: This method allows to create a new task (such as collect diagnostic data or check items or low-level discovery rules without config reload).

type.description: Task type. Possible values: 1 - Diagnostic information; 6 - Check now.

request.description: Task request object according to the task type. Correct format of request object is described in the Task object section.

historycache.description: History cache statistic request. Available on server and proxy.

stats.description: Statistic object properties to be returned. Default: extend will return all available statistic fields. Available fields for historycache: items - number of cached items; values - number of cached values; memory - shared memory statistics (free space, number of used chunks, number of free chunks, max size of free chunk); memory.data - history data cache shared memory statistics; memory.index - history index cache shared memory statistics.

top.description: Object to sort and limit returned statistic values, e.g. { "values": 10 }. Available sorting field for historycache: values (integer).

valuecache.description: Items cache statistic request. Available on server.

stats.description: Statistic object properties to be returned. Default: extend will return all available statistic fields. Available fields for valuecache: items - number of cached items; values - number of cached values; memory - shared memory statistics (free space, number of used chunks, number of free chunks, max size of free chunk); mode - value cache mode.

top.description: Object to sort and limit returned statistic values, e.g. { "values": 10 }. Available sorting fields for valuecache: values, request.values (integer).

preprocessing.description: Preprocessing manager statistic request. Available on server and proxy.

stats.description: Statistic object properties to be returned. Default: extend will return all available statistic fields. Available fields for preprocessing: values - number of queued values; preproc.values - number of queued values with preprocessing steps.

top.description: Object to sort and limit returned statistic values, e.g. { "values": 10 }. Available sorting field for preprocessing: values (integer).

alerting.description: Alert manager statistic request. Available on server.

stats.description: Statistic object properties to be returned. Default: extend will return all available statistic fields. Available field for alerting: alerts - number of queued alerts.

top.description: Object to sort and limit returned statistic values, e.g. { "media.alerts": 10 }. Available sorting fields for alerting: media.alerts, source.alerts (integer).

lld.description: LLD manager statistic request. Available on server.

stats.description: Statistic object properties to be returned. Default: extend will return all available statistic fields. Available fields for lld: rules - number of queued rules; values - number of queued values.

top.description: Object to sort and limit returned statistic values, e.g. { "values": 5 }. Available sorting field for lld: values (integer).

itemid.description: ID of item and low-level discovery rules.

proxy_hostid.description: Proxy about which Diagnostic information task will collect data. Ignored for 'Check now' tasks.
